text:
sasha (docs): Hey all — opened PR #842 for the Private/VPC migration guide (adds step-by-step network setup and common troubleshooting). CI preview is up but the docs CI is failing linkcheck + vale. Hoping for a quick sweep and reviewer assignment so we can get this merged before the sprint close. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · failed
  3 broken links detected:
   - docs/private/vpc.md: line 78 -> http://internal-old.example.com/setup (404)
   - docs/snippets/python/auth.md: line 12 -> https://old-sdk.example.com (redirect loop)
   - docs/private/faq.md: line 22 -> /nonexistent-anchor (anchor not found)
Run `make docs-linkcheck` locally or view full log: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/314159

ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · failed
  Rules triggered: PassiveVoice (2 occurrences), Complexity (1)
  Excerpts: "the service will be configured" (passive) — suggest: "configure the service"

devon (eng): I can take the link fixes. Looks like two absolute links that should be relative and one bad anchor. Will open a small patch to convert sdk url -> /snippets/python/auth.md and fix the anchor.

maria (platform): FYI vale flagged the troubleshooting section for passive voice — I can rewrite those two sentences without changing the steps. Avoid changing command examples.

kevin (docs): Quick note — spellcheck flagged lowercase `redwood` in a couple headings and `vpc` abbreviations. Our style guide expects `Redwood` and `VPC` (caps). I'll include a tiny style commit to fix casing.

devon (eng): Pushing a micro-commit now to replace the absolute links and anchor. Patch gist:
```bash
# replace old sdk host with relative path in snippets
git checkout -b docs/842-linkfix
rg "old-sdk.example.com" -l | xargs -L1 sed -i 's|https://old-sdk.example.com|/snippets/python/auth.md|g'
# fix missing anchor in faq
sed -i "s|\(#how-to-tls\)|\(#how-to-tls\)|" docs/private/faq.md
```

devon (eng): CI preview updated — linkcheck passed for those three noted links, but vale still flags two passive sentences and one Complexity rule in the networking rationale paragraph.

maria (platform): Quick rewrite suggestion (keeping commands intact):
"Replace: 'the service will be configured with a subnet and route'"
"With: 'configure the service with a subnet and route'"
I'll push as an amend to the same branch unless anyone objects.

kevin (docs): Please do — small wording is fine. Also adding `docs/needs-approval` label after the fixes so reviewers see it's ready.

sasha (docs): @kevin @maria PTAL when you have a minute. If both approve, we'll merge after green and tag as `release/docs-vpc-rc`. Can we avoid touching the big architecture diagram in this PR? Would prefer a follow-up.

kevin (docs): Reviewing now, should be done in ~45m.

maria (platform): LGTM for the copy changes, left two inline comments about clarifying a noun in step 4. Not blocking.

devon (eng): I've pushed the fixes and rebased onto main. Tests passing locally, CI re-run queued.

ci-bot: docs-ci/all · pending

kevin (docs): Approved. Added `docs/approved` label. :thumbsup:

sasha (docs): Thanks — merging when CI goes green. If anything else flares up, create a follow-up PR for diagram edits.

devon (eng): Thanks everyone — nice fast sweep.

ci-bot: docs-ci/all · success (15m)

sasha (docs): Merged and backported tiny casing fixes to `main`. Closing PR #842. :tada:
